restrict｜限制;约束.example: And, if any choices are provided, they are usually restricted to a few audio channels.
restrict｜限制;约束.example_translation: 而且，如果提供了任何选择，它们通常被限制在几个音频频道.

retain｜保持,保留.usage: 动词。例句搭配：retain the existing senior managers。

retirement packages｜退休金,退休福利.usage: 固定搭配。例句中的用法：retirement packages。

retirement packages｜退休金,退休福利.example_translation: 马鲁巴工厂的员工接到通知，工厂将在约6个月后停止经营并且会发给每位员工丰厚的退休金。

retirement｜退休.usage: 名词。例句搭配：announcing his retirement。
retirement｜退休.example: Since announcing his retirement, Mr. Kinsley has been busy trying to train his replacement.
retirement｜退休.example_translation: 自从宣布退休，金斯利先生就忙于培训他的接班人。

retire｜退休.example: Once Mr. Pennington retires, he will receive an annual pension of more than fifty thousand dollars from Packard Incorporated.

return｜返回,回来;送还.usage: 名词。例句搭配：on your return。

return｜返回,归还.example: Some items must be returned unopened.

revenue｜收入.usage: 名词。例句搭配：increase their revenues。
revenue｜收入.example: In a desperate move to increase their revenues to meet their sales goal, the company is planning to offer a special discount to its customers.
revenue｜收入.example_translation: 为了增加收入达到销售目标，那家公司铤而走险，计划给他们的顾客提供特殊的折扣。

revenue｜税收;收入;财政收入.usage: 名词。例句搭配：in tax revenues。

review｜审核;评论;复习;回顾.example_translation: Elisa Reigns Reatings在5个加拿大官方文化冲突中的回顾，温哥华的警察(Jerry Kirkland)与魁北克(Bruce Huard)违反规则的街头警察勾结,

right｜合适的;正确的.example: Mr. Chan's main role in the company for the next two weeks is to look for the right person to take over Mr. Shaw's position when he leaves at the end of the month.
right｜合适的;正确的.example_translation: 未来两周里，陈先生在公司的主要职责就是寻找一个合适的人选在本月末肖先生离职时接管他的工作。

rise｜上升;增加.example: The minerals boom has brought about an economic boom, which in turn has meant that real estate values have risen to record levels.
rise｜上升;增加.example_translation: 矿业繁荣带来了经济繁荣，这转而意味着房地产行业已经上升到创纪录的水平。

role｜作用;角色.example: To be successful in this role, you will have excellent communication skills, be proficient in all Microsoft applications, particularly PowerPoint, and have an outstanding eye for details.

route｜路线.example: Visit www.peoriacommutertrain.com to find out about routes, travel times, and costs.

routine｜日常工作;惯例.example: Creativity and productivity can be increased if our employees are able to spend less time doing repetitive and routine tasks.

safety guidelines｜安全指南.usage: 固定搭配，在句中作宾语：safety guidelines。

safety guidelines｜安全指南.example_translation: 受到政府监管部门的批评后，公司将在不久的将来公布修正后的安全指南。

safety｜安全.usage: 名词。例句搭配：about the safety。
safety｜安全.example: Since 1962 we've been helping families and businesses start new lives without the stress of worrying about the safety of their valued possessions.
safety｜安全.example_translation: 从1962年起，我们一直在帮助家庭和企业开始新的生活，而不再担心他们珍贵财产的安全。

salary｜薪水.example: Salaries are higher, too, but you have to commit to staying there for at least two years.

satisfaction｜满意,满足.usage: 名词。例句搭配：find the highest quality satisfaction。

satisfaction｜满意,满足.example_translation: 我相信，你将在我们的产品中找到质量最高的满意。
